newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: STIC and units reorganise business.
newsitem.headline: STIC and units reorganise business.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd and subsidiaries ST Computer Systems & Services Ltd and ST Electronic & Engineering Ltd said Monday they were rationalising their electronic systems integration business.
ST Electronic will acquire four companies from ST Computer, STIC and other parties, under the reorganisation.
The four companies are ST Stimulation Systems Pte Ltd, Agilis Communication Technologies Pte Ltd, CET Technologies Pte Ltd and Singapore Engineering Software Pte Ltd.
ST Electronic will pay Singapore $58.56 million for the companies to be satisfied by an issue of 45.04 million new shares at Singapore $1.30 each.

STIC chief operating officer Tay Siew Choon said in a statement the rationale for the exercise was to allow STIC to focus on its core businesses of infrastructure development and lifestyle and leisure activities.
